big: Rohan's payslip shows two lines he never thinks about: 'EPF employee' and 'EPF employer'. Every month, money is moving into a pot that will be his at retirement.

lines: I have an EPF through my job. My uncle, who runs a shop, has a PPF. Are they the same?
Both are long-term, government-linked savings. EPF is for salaried people and comes with the job. PPF is open to anyone, and you open it yourself.

intro: To see how the pot builds.
note: Not all of the employer share goes to the EPF account, since part goes to a pension scheme. Check your own payslip.

title: EPF and PPF
stops: EPF is for salaried staff, and the employer adds
The PPF rate is set by the government from time to time
VPF is a loan from your employer
caps: Both sides contribute a share of salary to the EPF account.
PPF has a fifteen-year term, with the option to extend.
The government sets and reviews the PPF rate, so it can change.
VPF is extra money you choose to add to your own EPF.

q: Rohan wants to save more for retirement through his payroll. Which option adds extra to his provident fund?
opts: A bank locker for cash notes
A credit card with a high limit
A shop loan from a relative
why: VPF lets an employee add more than the required share to the provident fund.
A locker stores items but earns nothing toward retirement.
A credit card is borrowing and not a way of saving.
A loan from a relative is debt and does not build a retirement pot.

q: Meena is self-employed. Which of these can she open on her own?
opts: An EPF account through her employer
why: EPF comes through an employer, so she has none to use.
Gratuity is paid by an employer, and she has none.
PPF is open to individuals, whether or not they have a job with an employer.
Employer matching needs an employer, which she does not have.

q: Rohan's PPF account reaches its 15-year mark. What can he do?
opts: Nothing, since the money is gone for all time
Extend it in blocks of five years, or withdraw it
Only withdraw it, since extension is not allowed
Move it into a credit card account
why: The money is not lost. It becomes available at the end of the term.
On maturity the holder can withdraw or extend, under the scheme rules.
Extension is allowed, so withdrawal is not the only choice.
A PPF balance cannot be moved to a credit card account.

q: The PPF rate is announced by the government. What does this mean for Meena?
opts: The rate is fixed forever on the day she opens it
The rate is set by her bank's branch manager
The rate rises whenever she pays more
The rate can change over the years
why: A rate reviewed from time to time is not locked for the whole term.
A branch manager does not set the PPF rate. The government does.
The rate does not depend on how much she pays in.
The government reviews and sets the rate, so it may move in future.

pts: EPF is for salaried people, and the employer adds a share.
PPF is open to anyone, with a 15-year term and a government-set rate.
VPF is extra you add to your own EPF.
